name: Jonas Sjöstedt - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: 2022 discharge: General budget of the EU - European Council and Council
part_text:
The European Parliament refuses to approve how the Council spent its 2022 budget. It says the Council has refused for years to answer Parliament's questions or attend hearings, so Parliament cannot check the spending properly. Parliament asks the Council to restart talks at the highest level to end the deadlock. It also repeats earlier criticisms, including about Hungary holding the Council presidency and about the rule requiring unanimous votes in some areas.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament formally refuses approval of the Council's 2022 spending.
- **Who it affects:** The Council, its Secretary-General, and European Union taxpayers.
- **What happens next:** Parliament asks the Council to open high-level talks to resolve the dispute.
